name: plataforma-bodas
description: Customizable wedding invitation platform with a private dashboard for the couple: bilingual RSVP with wishes, 3D gallery, music, countdown, gift box with QR and push notifications. Next.js 16 + Supabase.

paragraphs: Free wedding websites: couples design their invitation without an account, publish it and follow every reply from their dashboard.

Guests get a fast, bilingual, mobile-first invitation with RSVP, music, a 3D photo gallery and a gift box. The couple manages every detail from a dashboard and gets a push notification on their phone for every answer.
Website · Live demo · Create one · Try it · Architecture · Deployment
features: Landing page in Spanish or English (picked from the phone), with a real invitation running inside a phone, how it works and an FAQ.
One indexable demo per template (/demo/) with a Create yours with this template button.

Builder without an account (/crear): a 14-step guide — names, date, template, envelope and cover, parents, venue map, schedule, dress code, photos, music, gifts, replies — with a live preview of every step. Everything…
Sign in with Google or an emailed code (/entrar): no password to remember, Google's consent screen shows Lazo de Oro, and the email arrives in the language of the page.
Animated envelope that opens the invitation and starts the background music (the tap browsers require for audio).
